answer: Velvet attendance ledger. Each identity must answer randomized, time-bound attention challenges drawn from a shared fable feed, and only a continuous answer streak earns spendable credits. Missed or delegated challenges decay the streak, so an attacker running many sybils pays the opportunity cost of genuinely staffed shifts across all of them. A yarrow-marked audit trail logs response latency per identity, making parallel automation costly to sustain without detection.
